description: This file contains utility functions for managing and selecting containers within a Kubernetes pod, including default container selection and container lookup by name.

methods.name: FindContainerByName
methods.description: Selects a container from a pod by name, searching in containers, initContainers, and ephemeralContainers.

methods.name: FindOrDefaultContainerByName
methods.description: Returns a specified container by name or defaults to the first container, with optional warnings.

methods.name: AllContainerNames
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of all container names in a pod, including ephemeral and init containers.
